Commentary.Commentary: Now it's time for the visitors to put behind their day on the field and come back out roaring to chase the total. They will need a good start if they are to stand a chance today. The surface is a good one for batting and there's no reason they can't pull it off. Do join us for the chase in a short while.

The Pakistani bowlers were not as bad as the scorecard shows because they were not at all supported by their fielders. Hasan Ali was the pick of the bowlers as he ended with his career best figures of 10-0-52-5. The coaches will be dreading after such a poor fielding performance as they kept dropping catches at regular intervals.

Warner and Khawaja gave the home team a decent start and Smith joined hands with Warner to stitch a 120-run stand after Khawaja's dismissal. The former got to yet another century on this ground to continue with his rich form from the last Test he played here. Head and Maxwell added 118 runs in the last 10 overs as they got to their respective fifties in no time.
Australia have ended on a high after a comparatively slow middle overs. It has been an enthralling batting performance by the hosts as they have dominated the match with the bat throughout.

OUT! Sharjeel Khan finally takes a catch but it's a little too late. Hasan Ali picks up a 5-fer. Full on the stumps, Maxwell whips this over square leg. But it's straight into the hands of Sharjeel who somehow manages to hold on to this one. So, with that, AUSTRALIA FINISH ON 353/6!
FOUR! Full around off, it's lofted back over the bowler's head for the third boundary of the over.
FOUR! Poor line and it's been punished. On the pads, Maxwell clips it past the diving short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Another one on the shorter side, Maxwell pulls it to deep mid-wicket and gets a brace.

FOUR! Another misfield, this time it's by Shoaib Malik. Atrocious. Short and around off, Maxwell pulls it down to long on. There was no pressure whatsoever at all but Malik still lets it go through. Boundary!
Mitchell Starc is the next batsman in.
OUT! Full on middle and off, Wade looks to clear the long on fence. Doesn't exactly get underneath it and ends it lofting it straight into the hands of Imad Wasim who makes no mistake in taking it.
FOUR! BANG! Goes for the yorker but misses his mark completely. Ends up bowling a full toss around off and it's hit down to long off. Too powerful a hit and it goes across the rope.
FOUR! That's a ridiculous shot. Yorker from Junaid, well outside off, Maxwell makes room and squeezes it out behind square on the off side. Gets it over point and picks up a boundary.
Fuller length ball outside off, Maxwell looks to steer it down to third man but misses.

Another misfield, this time from the skipper himself. This is poor, really poor. Full toss around off, Maxwell hits it to Azhar Ali at mid off who just lets the ball go through him. Another couple taken.
FOUR! Great use of the wrists from Maxwell. He brings that bottom hand into play and flicks it over square leg. Gets a boundary to his name as he does so.
Low full toss, Wade stays leg side and slices it towards deep point for an easy single.
15th ODI fifty for Glenn Maxwell!

Fifty for Maxwell. Back of a length outside off, it's tapped to the right of Hasan Ali, who is blocked by Wade. It rolls towards mid on and the batsmen run back for the second. Glenn brings up a milestone and it's been a good one.
Another full delivery outside off, Glenn Maxwell makes a little room for himself and lofts it over the covers. It's cut off by the fielder out in the deep as two runs are taken.
Fullish on off, Matthew Wade slogs hard but drags it off the inner half through backward square leg for a single.
Short and angling in, Maxwell backs away to hit the tennis smash but doesn't connect well at all. It goes towards mid-wicket as a single is taken.
Low full toss on middle, Wade hits it down to long off for a run.
Back of a length around off, Maxwell mistimes the punch down to long on for one run.
Hasan Ali returns.
Fuller around off, driven back down the track to end the over.
Matthew Wade flicks it away with a wristy shot to mid-wicket. Two runs added to the total.
Too full on the stumps, it's hit down towards long on for a single.
Matthew Wade will replace Travis Head to bat next. Can Australia keep on scoring at this pace?

OUT! This time the catch is taken. Think we need to put it out in the press. Short and on the body. Head pulls it over square leg but he doesn't get the distance on it. It's straight down the throat of Shoaib Malik who shows his teammates how a catch is taken. A good, brisk knock from Travis Head comes to an end.
4th ODI fifty for Travis Head!

SIX! Seeing Head walk down the track, Amir shortens the length but Travis doesn't care. He muscles the pull shot over the mid-wicket boundary for a biggie. Brings up his fifty with that and the 100-run stand is up as well.
FOUR! THAT'S CRUNCHED! It's too full and well outside off, Head nails the cover drive and gets it in the gap. Sends it all the way to the rope for a boundary.
The batsman gets an inside edge on that which goes fine down the leg side. One run added to the total.

DROPPED! I don't know how many times I've said that today. Arrowed full outside off, Head squeezes it out aerially straight to Hasan Ali at short third man. He dives low to his left and can't keep a hold of the incoming ball. Two runs are taken.

SIX! Travis Head has really got a hold of that, hasn't he? It's in the slot for him and he's not going to miss out on it. Stands his ground and slogs it well over the mid-wicket boundary for half a dozen.
Short and outside off, Maxwell looks to slap it down the ground but gets a bottom edge behind. Single taken.
The batsman flicks it away with a wristy shot. The batsmen have picked up a couple of runs.
Tailing back in on middle and leg, it's flicked to mid-wicket for a run.
Back of a length outside off, Maxwell camps back and ramps it down towards third man. A poor throw from the man in the deep and that allows the batsmen to comfortably come back for the second.
Sloppy work from Sharjeel once again, Amir is not at all happy. Maxwell whips it through to deep mid-wicket. It's straight to Sharjeel but he still can't stop the second.

FOUR! It's in the air but it's just wide of the diving Pakistan captain. Maxwell lofts this to the left of Azhar Ali at mid off. Azhar dives full stretch to his left but the ball just beats him. Races away to the fence for a boundary.
Pounded in on a shorter length and it's pulled away by Travis Head wide of long on for a run.
Just back of a length and aiming the hips, it goes off Maxwell's thigh pad and a leg bye is taken.
FOUR! Back of a length around off, Maxwell stands tall and smacks it over Amir's head to send it across the boundary line. Powerfully hit.

ANOTHER DROPPED CHANCE! Sharjeel Khan the culprit once again. It's full and in the slot once more, Head lofts this over mid-wicket. Doesn't get enough power on it as Sharjeel out in the deep runs to his right to take it and gets under the ball well, but once again drops a simple catch. This is the second catch he's dropped today, first of Steven Smith and now Travis Head. Two runs are taken.
That ball has taken the inside edge of the batsman and thudded into his pads.
SIX! That's a clean strike! Fuller length ball on the stumps, Travis Head gets underneath this and slogs it high over mid-wicket. Sends it sailing into the stands for a maximum.
Back of a length outside off, steered to third man for a single.

Dropped but that's too harsh. It came back at him too quickly. Low full toss around off, Head drives it back towards Junaid. He sticks his right hand out but is unable to hold on to it. It rolls to mid off and a single is taken.
Slower one from Junaid Khan and Head is beaten by the lack of pace. He goes for the big pull but the ball goes under his bat.
Junaid Khan will bowl again.
Driven through the covers by the batsman. The batsmen have run through for a single.
50-run stand between Head and Maxwell!
FOUR! Back of a length around off, Head hangs back and pulls it through mid-wicket for a boundary.

If that had hit, Head would have been gone. He wasn't even in the picture. It's worked to mid-wicket by Maxwell and Head had already set off. There is a shy at the bowler's end by Imad Wasim but he misses. There's nobody backing up and so the batsmen take a single.
Spears a full ball very wide outside off, Glenn Maxwell with an open face looks to steer it square on the off side but cannot do so.
Head makes room and Amir follows him. The left-hander gets an inside edge onto his pads which goes behind to the right of Rizwan. A single is taken quickly.

Loud shout for an lbw but it's turned down. Length ball on middle and leg, Maxwell looks to whack it hard over the leg side but is hit on the pads. A leg bye is taken and no response is given by the umpire as the ball probably pitched outside the line of leg stump.
Mohammad Amir back on for another spell.
SIX! POWERFUL! Tossed up outside off, Head goes for a biggie this time. He has hoisted that one over the mid-wicket region. That ball went some distance.
Full toss outside leg, Maxwell misses out this time. He goes for a switch hit but is not able to make the desired contact and the ball goes towards covers for a single.
Head stays deep in his crease and punches it to long on for a single.
Outside off, Maxwell cuts it through point for a single.
Maxwell moves way outside his stumps towards his leg side, Hafeez follows him well and bowls on the pads. Glenn flicks it through square leg for a couple.
Tossed outside off, Head tries to drive it but the ball catches an inside edge and hits the pads. They still manage to run a single.
Mohammad Hafeez back on to bowl.
FOUR! INNOVATIVE! Full toss outside leg, The Big Show again brings out his reverse sweep this time over the point fielder for a boundary. Are we up for a Maxwell show today?
FOUR! MAXY ACT! Tossed up and Glenn hammers it down the ground over the bowler's head for a boundary. Sheer brute force here.
Tossed up, Head drives it towards mid off for a single.
Maxwell comes down the track and drives it towards covers for a single.
Outside off, Head guides it towards third man for a single.
Head dances down the track and defends it well.
Powerplay 3 has been signalled. This means 5 fielders will be allowed outside the 30-yard circle.
Outside off, Head cuts it through point for a single.
Maxwell drives it through covers for a single.

NOT OUT! Short into the body, Head pulls it towards the mid on fielder. Azhar gathers the ball and throws it at the non-striker's end for a run out. He hit the timber. The umpire goes upstairs to check. Replays show Head was just inside the increase.
A run out appeal against Travis Head is referred upstairs by the umpire.
Head goes for a biggie over mid-wicket but is unable to make contact with the ball.
Head gets in line of the ball and defends it from his front foot.
Short of a length outside off, Maxwell goes for a shot outside off and gets an inside edge which goes behind square on the leg side for a single.
Junaid Khan returns to the bowling attack.
Head punches the last ball of the over straight back to the bowler.
Maxwell gets in line of the ball and drives it through mid on for a single.

DROPPED! On the stumps, Maxwell goes for a sweep and top edges it. The ball goes in the air a bit over short fine leg. Hasan Ali goes back tracking but could not get hold of it. So the misery in the field continues.
Head stays deep in his crease and punches it for a single.
Tossed on the stumps, Maxwell drives towards mid on for a single.

SIX! HERE COMES THE BIG SHOW! Maxwell changes his stance and Wasim fires it on the stumps. Maxwell gets under it and reverse slogs it for a biggie. He cannot connect the normal shots well but he has timed this to perfection over point.
Length ball outside off, Head drives it towards mid off.
Head tries to play the delivery outside off but misses.

Five Leg byes! Angling into the stumps, Maxwell goes for a flick but is unable to get contact. The ball hit the pads and goes towards gully. Azhar Ali from slip goes to fetch the ball and has a shy at the non-striker's end but the ball goes running towards the boundary for four overthrows.
Good length delivery again, Maxwell steps out and goes for a biggie but is nowhere near the ball. The ball goes straight to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, Maxwell drives it towards covers.
Good length delivery outside off, Maxwell goes for a heave on the off side but gets beaten by the line of the ball.
Outside off, Head prods forward and pushes it to the cover fielder.
Floated up, Head gets in line of the ball and defends it.
Head drives it straight to the fielder at covers.
On the pads, Maxwell gets off the mark as flicks it through to deep mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, Head drives it through mid on for a single.
Tossed up outside off, Head punches it back to the bowler.
Maxwell stays back to this length delivery and blocks it out with a straight blade.
Glenn Maxwell is the next man in.

OUT! HE'S GONE! Hasan Ali with his second of the over. He's dismissed the two big fishes in the space of 3 balls. He comes running in and angles in a length ball on middle and leg, Smith shuffles too far across to flick it away but misses and is rapped on the pads. The visitors go up in a loud appeal and this time the umpire raises his finger. Smith isn't convinced though and after speaking with his partner, reviews the decision. The replays show the ball to be clipping the bails and that means that he's going to have to make the long walk back.
Steven Smith is caught leg before once more and given out this time. The Aussie skipper decides to review the decision.
Angles across a length delivery outside off, Head reaches out to this one as the ball takes a healthy edge. It flies through the vacant slip cordon as a run is taken.
Travis Head walks into the middle next.

OUT! Finally Pakistan take a catch and it's a good one by Mohammad Rizwan. It's fired on a fuller length well outside off, Warner backs away as he makes some room for himself and looks to smash it through the off side. Ends up getting an edge which flies behind. Rizwan dives low to his left and takes an excellent catch. Warner departs but not before playing a blinder of a knock. He walks back to a loud applause from the Sydney crowd. Australia would have liked him to hang around though for a little while longer, the stage was set for him to launch an onslaught.
Works this to mid-wicket once more but gets no run for it.
FOUR! It's too straight and it's been punished. Hasan Ali bowls this on middle and Warner dispatches this wonderfully. Whips it powerfully through square leg and picks up a boundary.
Warner stays deep in his crease and punches it towards Malik. The fielder has a throw at the stumps which is wide. They could have taken a run on over throw if Warner had not run that deep.
Floated outside off, Smith drives it towards covers. Hafeez makes a good stop but is unable to save the single.
Tossed up, Smith clips it through mid-wicket for a couple.
On the pads, Warner flicks it on the on side for a single.
SIX! That was coming! Short into the stumps, Warner stays in his crease and lofts it over mid-wicket for a biggie. That's gone the distance.
Smith gets in line of the ball and drives it towards mid on for a single.
Warner cuts it hard through the point region for a couple.
Low full toss outside off, Warner cannot punish it as he guides it towards the point fielder.
Length ball outside off, Smith shuffles and clips it on the leg side for a single.
Smith has driven the length ball towards mid off.
Warner punches it through covers for a single. He thought of going for  a biggie but changed his mind.
100-run stand between Warner and Smith!
Good length delivery outside off, Smith pushes it through covers for a single.
Hasan Ali has been called back into the attack.
Tad short and pitched outside off, hit away square on the off side for a run.
From around the wicket again, David Warner brings out the reverse sweep and plays it behind square on the off side for one.
Steven Smith walks down to this fuller ball and whips it over mid-wicket. A run is taken as the fielder out in the deep collects it.
The batsman has punched the ball off the back foot. They pick up a single.

DROPPED! And this time it's the dangerman who's been given a life. How can you even do that? Absolutely unreal stuff. Flatter one coming in from over the wicket, Warner backs away and looks to clear mid off. He doesn't as he lobs it towards Hasan Ali there, who dives forward to take it but spills a perfectly simple chance. Oh, my word...
Flatter ball around off, hit through the covers for a couple of runs.
Drinks break!

NOT OUT! Amir bowls a fuller length ball which was going across, Smith gets across and tries to flick it on the on side but he misses. The ball hits the pads and they appeal in unison for an LBW. It's not given so Pakistan call for a review. Replays show that the impact was way outside off and they have wasted a review.
Pakistan are reviewing for an LBW appeal against Steven Smith.
Again a yorker, Warner manages to stick it out for a single.
FOUR! WHAT-A-COMEBACK-SHOT! Short into the body, Warner pulls it really hard through the mid-wicket region for a boundary. That was brutally hit.
KNOCK OUT PUNCH! Inswinging, nearly a yorker delivery into the pads, Warner tries to flick it on the on side but is unable to make contact. He gets hit low on the pads and is down on the ground.
Length ball outside off, Smith pushes it towards mid off for a really quick single.
Angling into the stumps, Warner stays in his crease and pushes it towards point for a single.
Tossed up and attacking the stumps, it's played back down the track by the Australian captain.
Fullish length delivery from Imad Wasim, it's driven to the cover by Steven Smith for nothing.
Shorter one outside off, David Warner punches it through to sweeper cover and picks up a single.
Flatter one on the pads, it's flicked through the mid-wicket region for a double.
Defended off the front foot by the batsman presenting the full face of the bat.
Darts this across David Warner, just outside off, it's pushed quicker through the air as Warner backs away to cut it. Misses and it's collected by the keeper.
Smith gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Outside off, left alone by Smith.
12th ODI ton for David Warner!

Davey Warner reaches to yet another century but his first against Pakistan. Length ball outside off, Warner drives it through covers. The fielder saves the boundary but they run three. Warner has scored this hundred slower than his Test hundred which just came a couple of weeks ago.
Length ball outside off, Smith pushes it through the cover region for a single.
Outside off, Smith pushes it towards the point fielder.
Angling into the stumps, Warner tries to defend it but gets an inside edge towards fine leg. Calls for a double but settles for a single as Smith refuses.
Mohammad Amir has come back into the attack.
Tossed up outside off, Warner punches it through covers for a single.
On the pads, Smith clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Outside off, Smith defends it on the off side.
Tossed outside off, Smith punches it through covers for a couple.
Smith flicks it on the side. No run taken.
FOUR! Straying on the pads, Smith brings out his broom and sweeps it through the square leg region for a boundary.
Warner stays in his crease and defends it on the on side.
Smith clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short and on the stumps, Warner pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a single.
Warner lunges to the line of the ball to defend it.
Smith gets in line of the ball and drives it through mid on for a single.
FOUR! TIMING AND PLACEMENT! Short and outside off, Smith again cuts it elegantly through the point region for a boundary.
On the pads, Warner sweeps it towards short fine leg. No runs taken.
The batsman has played that off the front foot and into the ground.
Smith leans into the delivery and drives it towards mid-wicket for a single.
FOUR! PIERCED! Short outside off, Smith waits deep in his crease to cut it through the point fielder for a boundary. No use running behind that one.
Again on the pads, Warner flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
On the pads, Smith clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Short into the stumps, Smith punches it towards mid on. A fumble from the Pakistani skipper helps them get a single.
Tossed up, Warner drives it towards long off for a single.
Smith stays deep in his crease and punches it through covers for a single.
On the pads, Smith clips it towards square leg for a couple. That was really quick between the wickets.
Tossed up, Warner drives it through mid off for a single.
Warner prods forward and defends it.
Shoaib Malik will roll his arm now. Will be able to use his experience and pick up a wicket or two?
FOUR! Tossed up on the pads, Smith brings out the paddle and the ball goes towards backward square leg for a boundary.
Tossed up on the stumps, Warner half sits and sweeps it towards square leg for a single.
Full and Smith drives it towards long on for a single.
Tossed up, Smith drives it towards mid on.
On the pads, Warner clips it down the leg side for a single.
Tossed up, Warner drives it through covers for a couple.
Imad Wasim is brought into the bowling attack.
Warner stays deep in his crease and punches the ball for a single through covers.
Short ball into the body, Warner comes down the track and goes for a slog over mid-wicket. He checks his shot in the last moment and gets a couple.
Beamer on the body, Warner stays in his crease to defend it. Free Hit coming up.

DROPPED! Wide outside off, Smith gets his bat to it and tries to pierce the gap through the point region. The ball goes aerially straight to the right of the fielder at gully. Sharjeel sticks out his right hand but does not catch it. That was too casual from him there. Had he gone with both his hands then maybe it would be a different proposal altogether. The ball goes behind him for a single. Have they lost the plot here?
Good length delivery outside off, Smith pushes it towards the point fielder.
Length ball outside off, Smith walks across and tries to nudge it. But the ball catches the inner half of the the bat and goes to the keeper.
Good length outside off, Warner punches it through covers for a single.
Flatter ball which is hit down to long on for one run. That'll be the end of the over.
Drifting in on the pads, it's wristed through mid-wicket after coming forward for a couple of runs.
The Professor gives this some decent air and loops it up on middle and off, Davey hangs back and meets it with a straight bat.

FOUR! Hafeez drags the length back on this and bowls this short, it's on the stumps as Warner rocks back to this. Muscles the pull over mid-wicket and sends it across the rope for back-to-back boundaries.
FOUR! Excellent from David Warner. He kneels down to this tossed up delivery and sweeps it through backward square leg for a boundary.
From around the wicket, drifting in to the batsman, worked away to mid-wicket.
Warner stays right behind the line and pushes it towards mid on for a run.

Loud, loud shot for a caught behind but it's denied by the umpire. Mohammad Rizwan goes up in a huge appeal as he throws the ball in the air but then backs out of the appeal. Not sure why if he's so sure. Just back of a length in the off stump channel, Warner looks to push this away from inside the line as the ball goes past the bat. The bowler and the keeper think they've got the edge but aren't really sure. So, no review is taken. Good they didn't too, replays showed no edge was involved.
Played to the point region by the batsman. They pick up a single.

Good job once again by Shoaib Malik. He is enjoying his football today. It's a poor line from Junaid as he bowls this on the thigh pad, David Warner tucks this down towards fine leg. Shoaib Malik out in the deep runs to his left and stops it with his left foot. Three runs taken.

FOUR! Great shot from David Warner. He finds the gap and finds the boundary too. Fuller outside off, the southpaw drives it off the middle right through the covers. It rockets away to the fence. Beautifully played, that.
Fuller length ball on off, Warner leans across a touch and wrists it straight to the wide mid on fielder.
Junaid Khan is back into the attack. He's going to take Hasan Ali's place who still hasn't returned.
Floats this one up and attacks the stumps, it's eased back down to long on for a single to end the over.
Short and wide outside off, on a flatter trajectory, it's cut away to point.
Another push from Warner to the covers. Another dot ball. This is good pressure from Pakistan. It's important to control the run flow.
Angling in on a shorter length, on middle and leg, David Warner backs away and punches it to cover-point.
From around the wicket, Hafeez drifts it in on middle and off, Warner works this to mid-wicket but won't get any run for it.
Tossed up on the stumps, Steven Smith easily drives it down to long on for a single.
Hasan Ali has gone off the field. He's been having some trouble with his abdomen muscle and he's probably gone in to get that treated.
Outside off, Warner guides it towards the point fielder.
Warner stays deep in his crease and plays it towards mid-wicket.
Full outside off, Smith gets his bat to it and guides it past the diving fielder at point for a single.
Again a length ball outside off, Smith shuffles outside off but lets that through to the keeper.
Length ball outside off, left alone by Smith.
Angling into the stumps, Warner defends it on the off side. They run for a quick single.
Warner stays deep in his crease to punch it past point for a single.
Smith gets in line of the ball and drives it through mid on for a single.
Floated outside off, Warner drives it through mid off for a single.
Tossed up, Smith reaches out to the ball and drives it towards mid on for a single.
Tossed outside off, Smith shuffles way across and gets in line of the ball to defend it.
Tossed up, Warner drives it towards long on for a single.
Length ball outside off, Warner drives it towards extra cover for a single. The diving fielder does not get to it.

Full ball which was angling in, Smith shuffles across and plays it away off the inside half of the bat. The ball hits the pads and goes towards fine leg. The players appeal but the umpire is not interested at all.
Smith leans into the delivery and defends it.
FOUR! FORM CONTINUES! Seems like he is continuing from where he left at last time. Bowled on the pads, Smith clips it through square leg to get off the mark with a boundary.
Skipper Steven Smith is out there in the middle.

OUT! EDGED AND TAKEN! Length ball outside off, Khawaja goes for a drive but this time does not middle it. The ball catches the outside edge of the bat and goes behind the stumps for a catch. Rizwan dives to his left and gathers it. Ali has drawn first blood out here.
Length ball outside off, Khawaja pushes it towards the point region.
Drinks has been taken.
Tossed outside off, Khawaja drives it towards mid off for a single.
Warner flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
The batsman has played it towards mid-wicket.
On the pads, Warner clips it towards square leg.
Short outside off, Warner cuts it towards backward point but the fielder is at an unorthodox position.
Tossed outside off, Warner drives it towards covers.
Length ball outside off, Warner drives it through covers for a single.
On the pads, Khawaja clips it on the on side for a single.
A square drive, but no run this time.
Warner cuts it through point for a single.
Full on the stumps, Warner slog sweeps it straight to the fielder at mid-wicket. The catch is taken but it is a Free Hit and Warner is safe.
Free Hit coming up in the next delivery.
No ball! Hasan Ali has overstepped and Warner pushes the ball towards mid-wicket.
Full on the stumps, Warner drives it towards mid on.
Quicker on the pads, Warner clips it towards square leg for a single.
Again on the pads, Khawaja clips it on the on side for a single.
Warner plays it towards mid-wicket to pick up a single.
Width outside off, Warner cuts hard but finds the point fielder.
On the stumps, Khawaja clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Tossed outside off, Khawaja drives it towards covers.
Back of a length delivery which rose up a bit, Warner stays in his crease to defend it as the ball got upto him.
Good length delivery outside off, Warner plays it towards point with soft hands.
Length ball outside off, Usman guides it towards third man for a single.
Again pitched up outside off, Khawaja shuffles and drives it towards mid-wicket.
Length ball outside off, Khawaja drives it straight back to the bowler.
On the pads, Warner stays in his crease and half pulls it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Warner gets a single again. Tossed outside off, Warner pushes it on the off side for a single.
Short on the stumps, Khawaja punches it through the cover region for a single.
Tossed up on the pads, Warner drives it calmly towards long on for a single.
Short but zipped after pitching, Warner stays deep in his crease to defend that one.
On the stumps, Warner leans towards the ball to defend it.
Tossed up, Khawaja drives it towards mid on for a single.
Mohammad Hafeez is back into the attack.
On the pads, Warner clips it on the on side for a couple.
17th ODI fifty for David Warner! It's his second against Pakistan.

Outside off on a length, Warner has guided that one fine towards third man. A fine effort by Shoaib Malik at the boundary ensures that the ball does not find the fence but they run a couple. Warner gets to his fifty in style. That's his joint fastest fifty. Previously, he scored a half century off 35 balls as well.
Outside off, Khawaja cuts it through point for a single.
Sprayed on the pads, Khawaja flicks it towards mid-wicket.
On the pads, Warner clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Warner gets in line of the ball and defends it.
Hasan Ali will have a go with the ball now.
Australia have gotten off to a great start here. Warner and Khawaja are playing extremely well as the runs are coming thick and fast.
The batsman has pushed it to the cover region.
Again a short ball, the same result. Warner pulls it towards deep square leg for a single.
Short ball and Usman pulls it towards square leg for a single.

NASTY IT SEEMED! Full ball and Khawaja drives it straight back to the bowler. Junaid puts his right foot in the way to stop the ball and gets hit. The ball hits the right toe. It seemed dangerous but Junaid is quite calm about it. The ball goes towards the cover region after deflecting off his foot.
A boundary followed by a single. Outside off, Warner cuts it towards point for a single.

FOUR! WHAT TIMING! Good length delivery outside off, Warner stays deep in his crease and just guides it past the point region. The perfect timing made it difficult for any fielder to stop that ball. Warner is having his day once again at the SCG.

Nice length outside off, Usman pushes it back to the bowler. Amir grabs the ball and throws it furiously back at the stumps at the striker's end. No harm done but seems like that his nerves are getting onto him.
Outside off, Warner guides it towards third man for a single.
Length ball, Khawaja drives this one towards mid on for a single.
Slinging in, Warner waits for the ball and nudges it through mid-wicket for a single.
Back of a length delivery on the pads, Warner tries to clip it but is unable to make contact. The ball hits the thigh pad.
Again angling in to start with, Khawaja is getting these easy singles. He flicks it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Warner stays in his crease and pushes it towards the cover fielder.
Length ball outside off, Khawaja shuffles and flicks it towards square leg for a single.
Angling into the stumps,  Warner dabs it with soft hands towards point for a single.
Warner stays deep in his crease and defends it.
Angling into the pads, Warner clips it towards mid-wicket off his pads.
Good length delivery outside off, Warner pushes it back to the bowler.
Warner flicks it on the on side for a single.

Length ball outside off, Khawaja pushes it back to the bowler. Amir cannot stop and Khawaja calls in for a quick single. Hasan Ali at mid on is quick to collect it. Has a shy at the stumps but misses. Khawaja was still in if it had hit.
On a good length outside off, Khawaja defends it on the off side and thinks of a single but is quick to say no.
Back of a length delivery outside off, Khawaja stands tall and pushes it back to the bowler.
Khawaja stays deep in his crease to defend it.
On the pads, Warner clips it towards mid-wicket for a single.
Bowls this one outside off, Warner has a go at it and finds the outside edge towards third man for a single.
Short into the body, Khawaja pulls it towards square leg for a single.
Length ball outside off, Warner drives it wide of mid off for a single.
Angling into the stumps, Warner stays put in his crease to defend the incoming delivery.
Length ball outside off, Warner carefully waits for the ball and defends it.

FOUR! WIDTH AND WARNER SAYS THANK YOU! Outside off, Warner cuts it elegantly through the point region for a boundary. Every fielder could just stand and applaud there. Warner is cruising with the bat.
Khawaja camps back and defends the last ball of the over.

Good length delivery outside off, Warner cuts it beautifully through the point region. Shoaib Malik, the veteran covers some distance to his left from third man and stops the ball with his left leg. Three runs taken.
Fine leg is in the circle now...
Warner stays in his crease and defends it.

SIX! THAT'S GONE THE DISTANCE! Short ball into the body, Warner pounces on it and pulls it. The ball does not make great contact with the meat of the bat but it is still enough to cross the ropes. That's brutal from Warner.
Angling down the pads, Khawaja has a slight shuffle which helps him to guide the ball towards fine leg for a single.
Good length delivery outside off, Usman defends it well.
Again width outside off, lucky for Pakistan that this time he doesn't find the fence. The cut shot goes straight to the fielder at covers.
Back of a length delivery into the body, Warner stays deep in his crease and pushes it back to the bowler.
FOUR! GOOD SHOT! Length ball outside off, Warner waits for it and cuts it elegantly through the point region for the second boundary of the over. Warner is looking alarming for Pakistan.
FOUR! PIERCED! Angling into the body, Warner angles his bat and slices it through the cover region for a boundary. He made it look so easy.
Good length delivery outside off, Khawaja punches it through covers for a single.
The batsman shows the full face of the bat and defends the ball off the back foot.
Junaid Khan is brought into the attack.
Outside off, Warner pushes it towards the covers fielder. Babar makes a good stop there.
Angling down the leg side, Usman goes for a half pull but the ball hits the pads and goes on the on side. Leg bye is taken. Felt like it hit his gloves but the umpire signals it a leg bye.
FOUR! CLIPPED! Length ball into the stumps, a slight shuffle from Khawaja and he clips it through the mid-wicket region for a boundary.
Back of a length into the body, Usman stays deep in his crease to defend it.
Outside off, left alone by Khawaja.

FOUR! SUCH GOOD TIMING AND PLACEMENT! Angling into the body, Khawaja stays in his crease and glances it through the mid-wicket region. Once it crosses the infield it was always going for a boundary. Imad Wasim could have done better. Four runs.
Again on the pads, Khawaja flicks it towards backward square leg for a single.
Sprayed down the leg side, Warner clips it towards square leg for a single.
Short into the stumps, Usman stays deep in his crease and punches it back to the right of the bowler.
Short into the pads, Warner flicks it through the mid-wicket region for a triple. Good running there.
FOUR! TOP SHOT! Tossed up outside off, Warner stays in his crease and hoists that one over the cover region. That's a boundary and Warner has started to get a move on.
On the pads, Khawaja flicks it on the on side for a single. The visitors are giving away easy singles.
FOUR! Pitched up and Warner gets back to his best as he leans forward and drives it through the long off region for a boundary. Such gorgeous timing.
Length ball outside off, Khawaja is happy to see that one as he drives it towards the cover fielder. Babar Azam there fumbles which helps them take a single.
Back of a length delivery, Khawaja stays deep in his crease to defend it.
Goodish length delivery on the stumps, Khawaja is quick to shuffle and defend that one right in front of his eyes.
Way outside off, Usman has let that go through straight to the keeper.
Length ball first up, the ball swings away a tad bit after pitching. Khawaja shoulders his arms.
Mohammad Amir will bowl with the second new ball from the other end.
Short this time, Warner camps back and punches it towards the mid on fielder. No run taken.
Khawaja drives it towards long off. Easy singles are being given away.
Outside off, Warner gets off the mark with an easy single through the cover region.
Floated outside off, Usman reaches the line of the ball and drives it towards long off for a single.
Outside off, Khawaja leans into the delivery to defend it.
Tossed up, Usman prods forward and defends the first ball coming his way.

The players are out in the middle. David Warner and Usman Khawaja will open the innings for the hosts. Mohammad Hafeez will begin the proceedings with the ball for Pakistan. So it's spin to start with from the visitors.
Pakistan Playing XI - Azhar Ali(c), Sharjeel Khan, Babar Azam, Mohammad Hafeez, Shoaib Malik, Umar Akmal, Mohammad Rizwan(w), Imad Wasim, Mohammad Amir, Hasan Ali, Junaid Khan.
Australia XI - David Warner, Usman Khawaja, Steven Smith(c), Peter Handscomb, Travis Head, Glenn Maxwell, Matthew Wade(w), Mitchell Starc, Pat Cummins, Adam Zampa, Josh Hazlewood.

TOSS - AUSTRALIA WIN THE TOSS AND ELECT TO BAT FIRST. The hosts have made a couple of changes as they bring in Starc and Zampa for Faulkner and Stanlake. The Pakistani regular skipper comes back into the team for the outgoing Shafiq.

We have so been used to Smith playing the captain's knock and were able to witness one of the many last time around. The hosts have totally dominated the last match and will hope to finish it off at their captain's hunting ground where he averages 96 as a skipper. Pakistan on the other hand will want to make it even with their skipper coming back in for the all-important clash. The visitors will hope to come back to life with some energy after a disappointing outing in Perth. Welcome for the fourth ODI between Australia and Pakistan at the Sydney Cricket Ground.
